content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02080 If a new send request is received from the user (e.g. RTE or SwCluC) while sending n transmissions belonging together (e.g. after the 3 rd of 5 repetitions, see [SWS_Com_00305]) the AUTOSAR COM module shall cancel the outstanding trans- mission repetitions and start processing the new request within the next main function at the latest.
